doc.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023

chapter: Performing and the idea of free jazz
title: Jazz as America's classical music
summary: He considers jazz an art form and calls Ellington a master, citing Bud Powell and Monk.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: This might be an odd question but did you always think of jazz as an art form?

Absolutely. It’s America’s classical music you know, in a way. I mean it really is. I mean I think that Duke Ellington, you know, that’s not even a real question. Duke Ellington is a master, you know, and all of these people you know, yeah, yeah you know I mean you look at a Bud Powell solo. Jesus Christ you know I mean you know he’s just playing whatever he wants to play you know? Thelonious Monk you know.
If people listen to some of your solo alto work do you think that they feel that you’re playing whatever you want to play like you said Bud Powell was?
